verdict.rationale: Claude Managed Agents is described as a pre-built agent harness that 'runs in managed infrastructure' and is 'best for long-running tasks and asynchronous work.' The consumer plans list 'Hand off and schedule tasks,' and the Batches API supports asynchronous processing. Each of these is only a one-line mention, so it is unclear how a user would actually configure an automation or how scheduling works. Missing for 10: documented scheduling/trigger configuration for background automations, details on monitoring or notifications for unattended runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous background execution.
